description.value: Prophecy Cocktail Bar is an upscale cocktail lounge located within the Rosewood Hotel Georgia in downtown Vancouver, presenting an elaborate story-driven menu where each cocktail is inspired by writers, poets, musicians, and artists from around the world. The bar offers a curated selection of inventive house cocktails, classic serves, small plates, and a Cocktail Hour program. It positions itself as a sophisticated, design-forward destination with private event capabilities.
